metadata.description:
Discover the world through thirty fun and heartwarming stories with The Book of Cultures! The first children’s audiobook of its kind, this collection of fictional short stories takes young listeners on adventures near and far, all from the comfort of home. 

Each story follows a “buddy” from a different country, offering little ones a window into diverse cultures and how kids around the world live and think through relatable and engaging storylines. 

Perfect for bedtime, car rides, or classroom listening, these stories nurture empathy, spark curiosity and imagination, and encourage cultural awareness, helping raise the next generation of global citizens. 

Loved by families worldwide, The Book of Cultures is one of the top ten most-backed children’s books on Kickstarter, and has already reached readers in over 100 countries across the globe!
